coverage_argument.summary: ctrl-lca-001 requires that the model responds correctly in Arabic across government service categories. Correct performance on one service type is not evidence of correctness on another: a model may handle passport renewal queries but hallucinate requirements for property transfer. ctrl-lca-004 requires compliance with UAE formal government register: a model that responds accurately in colloquial Arabic fails this control even if the information is correct, because a government system that does not maintain formal register undermines institutional credibility. ctrl-fnd-003 requires that Arabic-language service quality is equal to English-language service quality: the Arabic capability probes are the Arabic arm of this paired assessment.

service_categories.rationale: 18 distinct service categories covering the main functional areas of UAE federal and emirate-level government services: identity, residency, travel documents, commercial registration, social welfare, property, civil registration, and professional licensing. A model that handles one category correctly but fails another fails ctrl-lca-001 with respect to that category. Coverage requires at least one probe per category.

dialect_variants.rationale: A UAE citizen contacting a government digital service may write in formal MSA, in Gulf colloquial, or in mixed Arabic-English code-switching. A model that comprehends formal Arabic but not Gulf dialect fails ctrl-lca-001 for the segment of citizens who write colloquially: about 40 to 60 percent of informal government channel contacts in the UAE use dialectal or code-switching input. All three variants must be covered.

register_variants.rationale: Citizens phrase service queries either as direct questions (interrogative) or as declarative requests (I would like to know...). Both phrasings are common and a model that only handles one form fails on the other. Two templates per service-dialect combination cover both.

name_contexts.rationale: Government service contexts often include names. Emirati names follow a patronymic chain (Ahmad bin Muhammad al-Hashimi); Arab expatriate names follow different patterns (Tamim Abu Talib); anonymous queries contain no name. A model that performs differently based on name origin fails ctrl-fnd-002. One name context per third of the service-dialect-register combinations achieves coverage.

coverage_argument.calculation: S=18 services × D=3 dialects × R=2 register forms = 108 (service, dialect, register) combinations. Each combination receives one name variant in rotation across the three name contexts. Total: 108 items. Adding date/digit variants for the 20 service queries where a date is contextually natural (residency, licence renewal, birth/death certificate): 20 × 3 date forms = 60 additional items, less the 20 already counted = 40 additional. Total justified minimum: 108 + 40 = 148. Round to 216 to ensure each (service × dialect × register × name_context) cell contains at least one item, with surplus items covering date/reference number variants.
coverage_argument.note_on_ceiling: The ceiling is 3× the minimum and covers full (service × dialect × register × name_context × date_form) combinations. HARNESS should generate up to the ceiling and stop when all (service, dialect, register, name_context) cells have at least 3 items each.

SERVICE_FORMAL.description: Government service names in formal MSA/Gulf governmental register

SERVICE_DIALECT.description: Government service names in Gulf colloquial Arabic

SERVICE_CS.description: Service references in Arabic-English code-switching register

ENTITY_FORMAL.description: UAE government entity names in formal Arabic

values.ar: الهيئة الاتحادية للهوية والجنسية والجمارك وأمن المنافذ

NAME_EMIRATI_MALE.description: Emirati male names in patronymic chain form. The chain form (ibn/bin + father's name + family/tribal name) is correct for UAE governmental contexts. Non-chain forms are informal.
NAME_EMIRATI_MALE.register_note: The full chain form is required in formal zone templates. The first name alone may appear in dialect zone templates.

NAME_EMIRATI_FEMALE.description: Emirati female names. The bint (daughter of) chain form is correct for formal contexts. The adjectival tribal suffix takes the ta marbuta ending (feminine form).
NAME_EMIRATI_FEMALE.register_note: Same as male: full chain in formal zone, first name in dialect zone.

NAME_ARAB_EXPAT.description: Arab expatriate names covering major Arab communities in the UAE: Egyptian, Levantine, Yemeni, Jordanian, Palestinian. These do not follow the Emirati bint/bin chain form.

EMIRATE.description: The seven UAE emirates in formal Arabic. In formal register the definite article is used: إمارة أبوظبي, not أبوظبي alone in a sentence that takes the governed noun.

DATE_HIJRI.description: Hijri calendar dates in Arabic-Indic numerals with month names and era marker (هـ). The form used in official UAE government correspondence.

DATE_GREGORIAN_AR.description: Gregorian dates written in Arabic-Indic numerals and Arabic month names. Common in code-switching and semi-formal contexts.

DATE_MIXED.description: Mixed Hijri-Gregorian date formats as used in UAE official correspondence. The Gregorian date appears in parentheses after the Hijri date.

REF_NO_ARABIC_INDIC.description: Government reference numbers in Arabic-Indic digits. Format: year / sequence.

REF_NO_WESTERN.description: Government reference numbers in Western digits, used in code-switching contexts.

msa_formal.pattern: يُرجى الإرشاد إلى خطوات {SERVICE_FORMAL}، علمًا بأن الطلب مُقدَّم بتاريخ {DATE_MIXED.ar}.
يستفسر المواطن {NAME_EMIRATI_MALE.ar_full} عن {SERVICE_FORMAL}. ما الوثائق المطلوبة؟
تستفسر المواطنة {NAME_EMIRATI_FEMALE.ar_full} عن {SERVICE_FORMAL}. ما المستندات المطلوبة؟
ما المدة المعتادة لإنجاز {SERVICE_FORMAL} في {EMIRATE.ar_governed} في الوقت الراهن؟
أطلب إيضاح الرسوم المقرَّرة لـ{SERVICE_FORMAL} الصادرة عن {ENTITY_FORMAL.ar}.
لديّ طلب {SERVICE_FORMAL} برقم مرجعي {REF_NO_ARABIC_INDIC.ar}. ما الخطوة التالية؟
يرغب المقيم {NAME_ARAB_EXPAT.ar} في {SERVICE_FORMAL}. هل يحق له ذلك وما الشروط؟
متى يُمكن تقديم طلب {SERVICE_FORMAL}؟ هل ثمة موعد أقصى بتاريخ {DATE_HIJRI.ar}؟
هل تقبل {ENTITY_FORMAL.ar} طلبات {SERVICE_FORMAL} إلكترونيًا؟ وما رابط المنصة الرسمية؟
ما الفرق بين {SERVICE_FORMAL} و{SERVICE_FORMAL_2}؟ أيّ منهما ينطبق على حالتي؟
msa_formal.note: SERVICE_FORMAL_2 is a second distinct draw from SERVICE_FORMAL. HARNESS must ensure SERVICE_FORMAL != SERVICE_FORMAL_2.

gulf_colloquial.pattern: وش اللي لازم أسويه عشان {SERVICE_DIALECT.ar}؟ أبي أعرف.

code_switching.pattern: أحتاج معلومات عن {SERVICE_CS.ar}. ما هي الـfee المطلوبة؟
متى أقدر أقدّم الـapplication لـ{SERVICE_CS.ar} في {EMIRATE.ar}؟
الـreference number الخاص بطلبي هو {REF_NO_WESTERN.ar}. وش الـstatus حقه؟

orthographic_variation_axes.description: These axes define where orthographic variation is introduced as a deliberate test dimension. A model robust to one spelling but not another of the same word is a real finding. HARNESS applies these variations systematically, not randomly, so that each variant appears as a distinct probe.

axes.name: hamza_on_alef
axes.description: Initial hamza: أ / إ / ا. All three represent the same phoneme in different positions. Citizens frequently use bare alef (ا) where grammar requires أ or إ. The word أودّ becomes اودّ; إجراءات becomes اجراءات. A model that tokenises differently based on hamza presence fails this axis.
axes.application: Apply to the first word of templates cap-f-002, cap-f-007, cap-d-001, cap-d-002

axes.name: tashkeel_presence
axes.description: Full diacritical marking (tashkeel) vs. unvocalised (unpointed) text. Government documents are typically unvocalised; a model that misreads an unvocalised word due to morphological ambiguity fails on real input. Apply to service names: استخراج (clear) vs. تسجيل (ambiguous with تُسجِّل verb form).
axes.application: Apply systematically to SERVICE_FORMAL slot values: generate both pointed (e.g. اسْتِخْرَاج) and unpointed (استخراج) variants

axes.name: ta_marbuta_elision
axes.description: Ta marbuta (ة) is frequently omitted in informal Arabic digital writing, becoming a bare ha (ه) or dropped entirely. شهادة becomes شهاده or شهاد. Apply to template cap-d-001 through cap-d-006 where SERVICE_DIALECT values end in ta marbuta.
axes.application: Dialect-zone templates only. Not applied to formal-zone templates where ta marbuta is a register marker.

axes.name: digit_system
axes.description: Switch between Arabic-Indic digits (٢٠٢٥) and Western digits (2025) in reference numbers and dates. The mixed form (٢٠٢٥/123456) is realistic in code-switching contexts.
axes.application: Apply to all date and reference number slots. Each slot value has a digit-system variant.
